reason: The README clearly describes a DSH integration that forwards image attachments to a configured vision model, validates the returned Evidence, and supplies it to a text-only reasoning model.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的视觉模型分析图片附件，将经过验证的结构化证据传递给文本推理模型。
summaries.en: Bridges image attachments to a configured vision model and passes validated structured evidence to a text-only reasoning model.

capabilities: Sends image attachments to a configured image-capable vision model through a DSH route
Parses and validates vision-model output into structured Evidence
Injects validated Evidence into requests for a text-only downstream model
Caches validated Evidence in memory per session
